lyrics:
[intro]
I hear my heartbeat in the quiet night
A little spark is turning into light
I’ve been waiting for this moment to arrive
Now I’m ready, I’m ready to rise
[verse]
Woke up with a heart full of dreams tonight
Found a little courage in the fading light
They said stay small, but I’m reaching high
A girl with a vision learning how to fly
Through the tears, I found my way
Turning every scar into a brighter day
[chorus]
I keep chasing light 'til the stars align
Young and fearless, yeah I’m shining bright
Fire in my heart, glowing through my veins
From the dark to the light, dancing through the rain
[verse]
Time keeps moving, but I’m moving too
Breaking all the limits I once knew
No more hiding, I’m chasing the flame
Writing my story, remembering my name
[chorus]
I keep chasing light 'til the stars align
Young and fearless, yeah I’m shining bright
Fire in my heart, glowing through my veins
From the dark to the light, dancing through the rain
[bridge]
Every fall, every storm made me stronger inside
Every broken piece taught me how to rise
[chorus]
I keep chasing light 'til the stars align
Young and fearless, yeah I’m shining bright
Fire in my heart, glowing through my veins
From the dark to the light, dancing through the rain
[outro]
